protocol: Pure-linear (no ANN) hyper-reduced POD-Galerkin RVE law: phi_f (39-mode free-dof POD basis) with a fixed classic-ECM Z_res rule (237 elements) for the Newton residual, and a separate fixed classic-ECM Z_sig rule (37 elements) for the online, native reaction-force stress -- see fe2_extension/linear_hprom_iterative_law_float64_claude.py. evaluate() called per step with q_prev threaded (continuation) across the held-out test trajectory (1150 steps). Reference is pann/data/alltraj_stage10_direct_energy.npz's stage10_strain/stage10_stress, same as hprom_ann_direct_stage10_metrics.json.
